### Reproducible Code Example

```Python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
Created on 16-03-2024

@user: Marek Sawicki
"""

import streamlit as st  # pip install streamlit
import os

komputer_Roberta = False

if komputer_Roberta:
    os.chdir('C:\\Users\\<user>\\Documents\\GitHub\\SpineTime_Streamlit\\ST_App')
else:
    os.chdir('C:\\Users\\<user>\\Documents\\GitHub\\SpineTime_Streamlit\\ST_App')
  

# -------- MISC --------------    
    
# # emojis: https://www.webfx.com/tools/emoji-cheat-sheet/
st.set_page_config(page_title="Spine Time Backend App", page_icon="graphics\ST_logo.png", layout="wide")

st.sidebar.markdown("# Main page 🦒")

# ---- MAINPAGE ----
st.markdown("""---""")
st.markdown("# Main page 🦒")
st.markdown("""---""")

st.markdown("This is SpineTime backend app for R&D purposes")

pain = st.slider('A pain scale?', 0, 10, 0)
st.write("My A-pain is: ", pain)

#st.page_link("pages/01_PainTest.py")

st.button("Pain Test Site", key=None, help=None, on_click=st.page_link("pages/01_PainTest.py"),type="primary")
st.image("graphics\REHApp.png")

#---- HIDE STREAMLIT STYLE ----
hide_st_style = """
            <style>
            #MainMenu {visibility: hidden;}
            footer {visibility: hidden;}
            header {visibility: hidden;}
            </style>
            """
st.markdown(hide_st_style, unsafe_allow_html=True)
```

### Steps To Reproduce

1. Installed and running 1.32.0
2. pip install streamlit --upgrage 
3. Install streamlit 1.32.2 
4. Rerun same app
5. Receive in Browser: "Bad message format, Tried to use SessionInfo before it was initialized"

App is running like 1.32.0:

  Network URL: http://192.168.1.9:8501

### Is this a regression?

- [X] Yes, this used to work in a previous version.

### Debug info

- Streamlit version: 1.32.2
- Python version: 3.11.8
- Operating System: Win10
- Browser: Opera 107.0.5045.36 (Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/121.0.0.0 Safari/537.36 OPR/107.0.0.0)

### Additional Information

gold.summary: 1.32.2 shows 'Bad message format, SessionInfo...' while 1.32.0 works; Windows/Anaconda install warnings.
hypotheses: broken/mixed install in conda env (protobuf or partial upgrade)
acceptable_next_steps: Ask protobuf version and to test in a fresh environment
must_not: claim fixed in a specific version
gold.reference: Maintainer asked protobuf version; couldn't reproduce; later fix in 1.36 added SessionInfo check.
